ad_placement_notes.note: beehiiv ad-network placement limit discovered: a single post supports only ONE 'primary' ad slot. Attempting two or three advertisementOpportunity nodes with data-advertisement-kind='primary' fails with 'No primary ad slot is available in this post'. Fix: place the top-paying offer as primary and any additional offers as data-advertisement-kind='secondary'. This run placed 1 primary + 2 secondary and all three were accepted. Offer IDs rotate on every list_ad_offers call, so re-fetch immediately before save_post.
